summary: Interest you paid out of your taxable income on a loan from a financial institution or an approved charitable institution, for your own higher education or a relative's, is deducted in full. It runs for a fixed number of years from the year you start paying interest, or until the interest is paid off, whichever ends first. A relative is your spouse, your children, or a student you are the legal guardian of. Only the old regime allows it.

routes.name: Interest on a loan for higher education
routes.description: The whole of the interest paid in the year.

disqualifiers.description: It is not deducted in the default regime.
Interest paid after the years the deduction runs for is not deducted.
